answer: Escrow plus a public referral graph stops bulk forgery. Each identity locks 40 POA for 20 epochs under a sonnet-strict declaration. Referrals are public: the graph grows like an orchard, star clusters flagged. Peers may dispute suspects; a proven fake forfeits 40 POA, its referrer 20. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 40 = 4,000 POA against a ~900 POA epoch pool. An honest agent pays once, its escrow thawing at a glacier pace, returned in full.
